# Ventriloc — Style Reference

> Index tabs pulled from a concrete drawer, with one brass button. PolySans at regular weight sets the headlines on warm-gray concrete, a single 1px ink rule is the only line work, and brass ochre marks the action.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Ventriloc speaks a tabbed-ledger consulting language: content panels round only their leading edge (8px 0 0 8px) and run off the right side of the viewport, so the page reads as a stack of index tabs pulled from a drawer. The canvas is #f5f5f5, panels sit on #efefef, raised elements on #ffffff, warm feature blocks on #ebe6dd, and inverted bands on #202020 or #3c1e1a. The chromatic budget is two working hues. Brass #816729 owns identity and the single action, and ember #ff682c is rationed to six inline highlights. Typography pairs PolySans at weight 400 for every headline (66, 40 and 32px, tracked −0.02em) with Inter at weight 500 for body. Medium-weight body and regular-weight display invert the usual contrast, and the 1.65 jump from 40 to 66px carries hierarchy, with weight playing no part in it. Shape mixes 20px pill buttons, a 200px nav capsule and one-sided panel corners, with zero shadows anywhere. The whole reads as an analyst's binder rather than a SaaS dashboard.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fog Canvas | `#f5f5f5` | `--color-fog-canvas` | Body background, the 80px left rail, and label color on brass and ink fills. It is a warm-neutral base one step lighter than the panels it carries. |
| Concrete Panel | `#efefef` | `--color-concrete-panel` | Leading-edge panels that bleed off the right viewport edge, with 11 background uses. It is the workhorse container, separated from canvas by a 6-point gray shift alone. |
| Paper White | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-white` | Floating nav capsule, raised inner cards and white type on dark fills, with 11 background uses. As the brightest step, it reads as lift without needing a shadow. |
| Mist Tile | `#e8e8e8` | `--color-mist-tile` | A single inset tile inside a concrete panel, used once. It is the deepest neutral recess. Do not use it as a page background. |
| Linen Sand | `#ebe6dd` | `--color-linen-sand` | Warm sand surface behind 3 feature blocks. It ties the neutral grays to the brass accent without adding a second saturated hue. |
| Ink | `#202020` | `--color-ink` | Headlines, nav labels, the lone 1px rule and 4 dark fills, with 33 text uses. This near-black keeps 66px PolySans from turning harsh the way #000000 would. |
| Graphite Body | `#4d4d4d` | `--color-graphite-body` | Lead paragraphs at 18px Inter 500, with 15 uses. The mid-gray drops body copy below headline ink while holding contrast on #efefef. |
| Pewter Caption | `#828282` | `--color-pewter-caption` | Dropdown service links, the cookie link and meta text, with 22 uses. It is the tertiary tier. Do not use it for paragraphs longer than one line. |
| Brass Signal | `#816729` | `--color-brass-signal` | Hero field, Contact us pill fill, 13px credential kickers and the inactive FR link. It is the identity hue and the only action color. Do not set body paragraphs in it. |
| Ember Spark | `#ff682c` | `--color-ember-spark` | Six inline text highlights inside headings and lists. It works as punctuation rather than decoration, a hot spark against muted brass. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Umber Panel | `#3c1e1a` | `--color-umber-panel` | Three dark-brown fills for inverted bands and media mats. It is a warmer alternative to #202020 that keeps dark sections inside the brass family. |
| Cobalt Badge | `#0064b5` | `--color-cobalt-badge` | A one-off fill on a single partner credential, used once. It is vendor color and decorative-only. Do not reuse it in interface components. |

## Tokens — Typography

### PolySans — regular-weight display grotesk for every headline, nav label and button · `--font-polysans`

- **Substitute:** Schibsted Grotesk at 450, Hanken Grotesk at 450, Manrope at 450. PolySans Neutral Regular draws slightly heavier than a nominal 400, so a plain 400 in these substitutes reads too thin at 66px.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 12px, 13px, 16px, 32px, 40px, 66px
- **Line height:** 0.91 (66px), 1.2 (40px), 1.19 (32px), 1.0 to 1.13 (16px), 1.38 (13px), 1.0 (12px)
- **Letter spacing:** −1.32px at 66px, −0.8px at 40px, −0.64px at 32px, 0px at 16px and below
- **Role:** A single weight across six sizes is the signature. Headlines are big and quiet, and hierarchy comes from size alone, where convention would step up to 600 or 700. The −0.02em tracking, applied only from 32px upward, tightens display lines into solid blocks. The 0.91 leading at 66px pushes the headline even denser than the 1.0 to 1.1 most agency sites use. At 12 and 13px the face switches to uppercase for micro-labels, so one family covers both the loudest and the quietest text on the page.

### Inter — medium-weight body and UI text · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter itself is free and should be loaded at 500. Otherwise use Roboto Flex at 500 or Manrope at 500. All three match Inter's stroke at the same nominal weight.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 18px
- **Line height:** 1.33 (12px), 1.38 (13px), 1.43 (14px), 1.33 (15px), 1.5 (16px), 1.33 (18px)
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at every size
- **Role:** Weight 500 is the body default, with 48 of 70 Inter elements set in it. That is deliberately heavier than the conventional 400 reading weight, so body copy holds up against the ink-dense PolySans display. Weight 400 is reserved for 14px dropdown links and 12px meta text, and 600 appears exactly once. Untracked Inter beside tracked PolySans gives two textures: compressed display and open, even text.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter | 400 | 12px | 1.33 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Inter | 500 | 13px | 1.38 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter | 400 | 14px | 1.43 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 500 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter | 500 | 18px | 1.33 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| heading | PolySans | 400 | 32px | 1.19 | -0.64px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | PolySans | 400 | 40px | 1.2 | -0.8px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | PolySans | 400 | 66px | 0.91 | -1.32px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in PolySans at weight 400 (66px, 40px, 32px) with −0.02em tracking — size alone carries hierarchy, which is the system's typographic thesis.
- Round panels only on the leading side with 8px 0px 0px 8px and run them flush to the right viewport edge — the one-sided corner is what makes sections read as pulled tabs.
- Keep body copy at Inter 500, 16px or 18px — medium weight balances the dense 0.91-leading display and stops paragraphs looking faint.
- Reserve #816729 for the Contact pill, the hero field, 13px credential kickers and the alternate-language link — four placements keep brass legible as "action and identity".
- Separate surfaces by tonal steps only: #f5f5f5 canvas, #efefef panel, #ffffff raised — a 6-to-10-point gray shift replaces every shadow.
- Space sections at 120px and keep text measures between 500px and 662px — wide air around narrow columns gives the reading pace of a report.
- Use a 20px radius on 40px-tall buttons and a 200px radius only on the floating nav — full rounding marks interactive chrome and nothing else.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 600 or 700 — PolySans at 400 is non-negotiable, and heavier display weights turn the quiet-authority thesis into generic SaaS shouting.
- Don't round all four panel corners to 8px — symmetric cards lose the tab-from-a-drawer reading and collapse into a conventional card grid.
- Don't add box-shadows such as 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) to panels or the nav — the system has zero shadows, and depth comes from #efefef against #f5f5f5.
- Don't make #ff682c a button fill — ember is capped at six inline text highlights, and as a CTA it would outshout #816729 and split the action color.
- Don't set paragraphs in #828282 — Pewter is a 14px link and meta tone, and long copy at that contrast on #efefef becomes tiring to read.
- Never pad nav menu triggers with borders or fills — the secondary tier is bare PolySans 16px in #202020, and outlined ghost buttons double the visual noise inside a 200px capsule.
- Never set PolySans tracking below −1.32px at 66px or apply negative tracking under 32px — tight tracking is reserved for display sizes, and small text crushes.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #f5f5f5 (Fog Canvas)
- panel: #efefef (Concrete Panel)
- raised surface: #ffffff (Paper White)
- primary text: #202020 (Ink)
- body text: #4d4d4d (Graphite Body)
- tertiary text: #828282 (Pewter Caption)
- highlight: #ff682c (Ember Spark)
- primary action: #816729 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use neutral bars in #202020, #4d4d4d and #828282 on #efefef, with #816729 as a solid fill only for the single series being argued, ember #ff682c only as a 2px point marker, and every other brand color held at 30% opacity tints so brass stays the one saturated mass on the page.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a primary action button labeled "Contact us": background #816729, text #f5f5f5, no border, border-radius 20px, padding 0 20px, height 40px, font PolySans (fallback Schibsted Grotesk at 450) at 16px, weight 400, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing 0px, no shadow. On hover, shift the background to #202020 and keep text #f5f5f5. Place it at the right end of the navigation capsule with an 8px gap from the language toggle.

2. Build a floating navigation bar: position fixed, 20px from the top, horizontally centered, background #ffffff, border-radius 200px, no border, no shadow, padding 0 20px, items 40px tall with 8px gaps. Left: a 191 × 34px wordmark in #202020. Center: three text buttons ("services", "achievements", "ventriloc") in PolySans 16px weight 400, color #202020, transparent background, 0px radius, padding 0 12px 2px 18px. Right: an FR/EN toggle (PolySans 13px weight 400, padding 0 13px, height 32px, active #202020, inactive #816729) and the brass Contact pill.

3. Build a leading-edge content panel: page canvas #f5f5f5, panel background #efefef, margin-left 80px, flush to the right viewport edge, border-radius 8px 0px 0px 8px, padding 40px, no border, no shadow. Inside, use a 2-column layout with a 20px gap. On the left, an h2 at 602px width in PolySans 32px, weight 400, line-height 1.19, letter-spacing −0.64px, color #202020. On the right, a list in Inter 16px weight 500, line-height 1.5, color #202020, with 20px between items. Add a corner tab label above the heading: PolySans 12px uppercase, #ffffff fill, radius 6px 0px 0px 0px, padding 2px 8px.

4. Build a hero section: a full-bleed block 720px tall with background #816729, no gradient, no radius. Set a 713px-wide headline in PolySans 66px, weight 400, line-height 0.91, letter-spacing −1.32px, color #202020, offset 120px from the left. Below it, with a 20px gap, place a 500px-wide paragraph in Inter 18px weight 500, line-height 1.33, color #4d4d4d, then a credential line in Inter 13px weight 500, color #816729, with items separated by "|". Leave 120px below before the first panel.

## Components

### Pill Button — Brass (Primary)

**Role:** The single conversion action, "Contact us"

A 20px radius on a 40px-tall button produces a true pill, the only fully rounded action on the page. It communicates that brass means "talk to us" and nothing else, so use it once per viewport.

### Text Button — Menu Trigger (Secondary)

**Role:** Nav dropdown triggers for main sections

Bare type acting as a button. The spec for "services", "achievements" and "ventriloc" is a transparent background inside the white nav capsule, #202020 text, no border, 0px radius, 0 12px 2px 18px padding with mirrored values on the outer items, 40px height, PolySans 16px at weight 400, and no shadow. The 2px bottom padding optically lifts lowercase labels to center. The secondary tier is deliberately stripped of fill and outline, which runs anti-convention to the usual ghost-button border.

### Floating Pill Navigation Bar

**Role:** Fixed site header and menu

A floating white capsule. The bar is position-fixed, filled #ffffff (estimated), with a 200px radius and no border or shadow. It holds the 191 × 34px Ventriloc wordmark in #202020 on the left, three PolySans 16px menu triggers, the FR/EN toggle, and the brass Contact pill on the right, every item 40px tall with 8px gaps. The 200px radius is the system outlier against 8px panels, and it is allowed because a capsule floating over panels must read as detached chrome.

### Language Toggle — FR / EN

**Role:** Bilingual switch inside the nav

A two-letter switch where color carries state. Each link is 43 × 32px with a transparent background, no border, 0px radius, 0 13px padding (0 8px 0 13px on FR), PolySans 13px at weight 400 with 1.38 line height, and no shadow. The current language renders #202020 and the alternate renders #816729. Brass here marks "the other option", a quiet second use of the action hue that still points to a navigation event.

### Dropdown Service Link

**Role:** Service entries inside mega-menu

Small, gray, utilitarian. Links such as "Data Visualization", "Data Engineering" and "Data Governance" use Inter 14px at weight 400 with 1.43 line height, #828282 text, a transparent background, no border, 0px radius and 0px padding, stacked at 8px gaps. Dropping from PolySans to Inter, and from Ink to Pewter, demotes these to an index list rather than primary navigation, which is the right register for a catalog of 10+ services.

### Brass Hero Field

**Role:** Full-bleed opening color plate

A flat ochre slab. The hero opens with a full-bleed #816729 field 720px tall at a 1280px viewport (estimated from the screenshot), with no gradient, radius or border. The 713px-wide headline in PolySans 66px at weight 400, 0.91 line height and −1.32px tracking in #202020 is paired with an 18px Inter 500 lead in #4d4d4d. Spending the entire budget of the brand hue at the very top lets every later brass touch read as a callback.

### Credential Kicker Line

**Role:** Pipe-separated partner and expertise tags

A typographic trust badge. Lines such as "Microsoft Fabric & Azure Experts | Fivetran Experts" are set in Inter 13px at weight 500 in #816729, with no background, border, radius or padding, at widths of 316px and 662px. Vertical pipes replace badge chips. Where convention would use pill chips, the expertise list stays as running text tinted brass, which signals authority rather than a sticker wall.

### Leading-Edge Panel (Main Content Card)

**Role:** Primary section container, right-bleeding

The signature container. Each panel uses a #efefef fill with no border, an 8px 0px 0px 8px radius, 40px internal padding, and no shadow. It starts 80px in from the left viewport edge and runs flush to the right edge, leaving a #f5f5f5 rail on the left. Only the leading corners round, so the panel reads as a tab drawn out of the right margin. Use it for every major section, and alternate the fill with #ebe6dd for warmer feature blocks.

### Benefit List Block

**Role:** Outcome bullets inside service panels

A plain stacked checklist. The 602 × 208px block lists items such as "Improve data quality" and "Integrate artificial intelligence" in Inter 16px at weight 500 with 1.5 line height in #202020, with no background, border, radius or padding, and 20px between items. It sits beside a PolySans 32px heading at the same 602px width. Outcomes are stated in body ink rather than icons, which keeps the consultancy tone factual.

### Corner Tab Label

**Role:** Section index tags, top-left rounded

A filing tab, cut on one corner. The label is PolySans 12px at weight 400, uppercase, in #202020 on a #ffffff fill, with a 6px 0px 0px 0px radius and 2px 8px padding. Rounding a single corner echoes the panel's leading-edge rule at a smaller scale, the only element where the asymmetry shrinks to 6px. It is used 7 times to number or name sections.

### Partner Logo Row

**Role:** Client and partner proof strip

A monochrome logo rail. Logos are images normalized to a 50px height at widths from 48px to 125px, with 0px radius, no border, no container fill and no shadow, spaced at 40px gaps on the concrete panel. Equal height rather than equal width is the deliberate choice: wordmarks keep their natural proportions and the row reads as a typeset line.

### Testimonial Attribution

**Role:** Quote speaker name and title

A signature line. "Adrien Bourdon, BI Team Lead" is set in Inter 18px at weight 400 in #202020, 460px wide, with no background, border, radius or padding, and the title sits under the name in #828282 at 14px. Dropping to weight 400 here, one step below the 500 body default, makes the attribution recede beneath the quote it signs.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every headline in PolySans at weight 400 (66px, 40px, 32px) with −0.02em tracking — size alone carries hierarchy, which is the system's typographic thesis.
- Round panels only on the leading side with 8px 0px 0px 8px and run them flush to the right viewport edge — the one-sided corner is what makes sections read as pulled tabs.
- Keep body copy at Inter 500, 16px or 18px — medium weight balances the dense 0.91-leading display and stops paragraphs looking faint.
- Reserve #816729 for the Contact pill, the hero field, 13px credential kickers and the alternate-language link — four placements keep brass legible as "action and identity".
- Separate surfaces by tonal steps only: #f5f5f5 canvas, #efefef panel, #ffffff raised — a 6-to-10-point gray shift replaces every shadow.
- Space sections at 120px and keep text measures between 500px and 662px — wide air around narrow columns gives the reading pace of a report.
- Use a 20px radius on 40px-tall buttons and a 200px radius only on the floating nav — full rounding marks interactive chrome and nothing else.

### Don't

- Don't bold headlines to 600 or 700 — PolySans at 400 is non-negotiable, and heavier display weights turn the quiet-authority thesis into generic SaaS shouting.
- Don't round all four panel corners to 8px — symmetric cards lose the tab-from-a-drawer reading and collapse into a conventional card grid.
- Don't add box-shadows such as 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) to panels or the nav — the system has zero shadows, and depth comes from #efefef against #f5f5f5.
- Don't make #ff682c a button fill — ember is capped at six inline text highlights, and as a CTA it would outshout #816729 and split the action color.
- Don't set paragraphs in #828282 — Pewter is a 14px link and meta tone, and long copy at that contrast on #efefef becomes tiring to read.
- Never pad nav menu triggers with borders or fills — the secondary tier is bare PolySans 16px in #202020, and outlined ghost buttons double the visual noise inside a 200px capsule.
- Never set PolySans tracking below −1.32px at 66px or apply negative tracking under 32px — tight tracking is reserved for display sizes, and small text crushes.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Fog Canvas | `#f5f5f5` | Page body and the 80px left rail exposed beside every panel |
| 1 | Concrete Panel | `#efefef` | Leading-edge section panels that bleed off the right edge |
| 2 | Linen Sand | `#ebe6dd` | Warm alternate panel for feature and service blocks |
| 3 | Paper White | `#ffffff` | Floating nav capsule, corner tabs and raised inner cards |
| 4 | Ink | `#202020` | Inverted bands and dark closing sections |

## Elevation

The system carries zero box-shadows across every sampled element, so elevation is tonal layering. A panel rises from the #f5f5f5 canvas by darkening to #efefef, and the nav floats by brightening to #ffffff and taking a 200px capsule radius. Detachment is signaled by shape and position (fixed placement, a left-side 80px rail) rather than blur. The interface feels like flat card stock laid on a desk, physical and printed, rather than glass layers hovering above a screen.

## Imagery

Imagery is sparse and typographic. The opening plate is a flat #816729 color field 720px tall rather than a photograph. Proof comes from monochrome partner and client logos normalized to 50px height with 0px radius, no border and no container. Testimonials carry names and titles without avatar frames. The page uses no illustration, gradients, glows or orbs. The single cobalt #0064b5 fill belongs to a vendor credential and is decorative, not a system token for builders. Icons stay out of service lists, which state outcomes as Inter 500 text. Unlike the dashboard-screenshot heroes that are conventional for BI consultancies, the narrative here is expertise shown through language, credentials and named people rather than through product chrome.

## Layout

The page runs fluid and full-bleed at viewports up to 1905px, with 120px side gutters on headings and text measures capped at 500px and 662px. Sections stack at 120px intervals (85px to 140px). The hero is a full-bleed brass field carrying a 713px headline column and an 18px lead. After the hero, sections alternate between #efefef and #ebe6dd leading-edge panels that start 80px from the left edge and bleed to the right, with a 2-column split inside each: a 602px heading on the left and a benefit list or copy on the right. Logo rows run 5 across at equal 50px height. The nav is fixed and floats as a #ffffff 200px capsule with 40px items, logo left and Contact pill right. The footer is a quiet testimonial-and-links band in Inter. At 375px, drop display to 40px and the section gap to 70px, keeping 20px side gutters. Density: spacious.

Charts use neutral bars in #202020, #4d4d4d and #828282 on #efefef, with #816729 as a solid fill only for the single series being argued, ember #ff682c only as a 2px point marker, and every other brand color held at 30% opacity tints so brass stays the one saturated mass on the page.

Inside, use a 2-column layout with a 20px gap. On the left, an h2 at 602px width in PolySans 32px, weight 400, line-height 1.19, letter-spacing −0.64px, color #202020. On the right, a list in Inter 16px weight 500, line-height 1.5, color #202020, with 20px between items. Add a corner tab label above the heading: PolySans 12px uppercase, #ffffff fill, radius 6px 0px 0px 0px, padding 2px 8px.

4. Build a hero section: a full-bleed block 720px tall with background #816729, no gradient, no radius. Set a 713px-wide headline in PolySans 66px, weight 400, line-height 0.91, letter-spacing −1.32px, color #202020, offset 120px from the left. Below it, with a 20px gap, place a 500px-wide paragraph in Inter 18px weight 500, line-height 1.33, color #4d4d4d, then a credential line in Inter 13px weight 500, color #816729, with items separated by "|". Leave 120px below before the first panel.

## Leading-Edge Rounding

The defining discipline is asymmetry: content panels round only the corners that face the reader's entry point (8px 0px 0px 8px), corner tabs round only the top-left (6px 0px 0px 0px), and the right side of every panel disappears into the viewport edge. That one rule turns a stack of gray rectangles into tabs pulled from a drawer. Three moves break it: symmetric 8px cards centered inside a max-width container, a right-side margin that closes the bleed, or a shadow that makes panels float instead of slide. To extend the system, apply the rule by direction. A new panel type gets left-only rounding and a right bleed, a nested tile inside a panel may take the full 8px because it no longer touches an edge, and nothing new gets a radius outside the 3, 6, 8, 12 and 20px steps.

## Brass Rationing

Brass #816729 is spent at full volume once, as the hero field, and afterwards only in small doses: one 40px Contact pill, 13px credential kickers and the alternate-language link. Ember #ff682c gets six inline highlights and no fills. That ration is what lets a muted ochre do the work a saturated blue does on conventional B2B sites. Brass buttons in every section would break it, as would ember as a second CTA or brass body paragraphs. Data-viz palettes that put four saturated series beside the brand hue would break it too. Extend the system by adding neutrals, such as another warm step between #ebe6dd and #efefef, or dark bands in #3c1e1a. Do not add hues. Any new interactive state borrows #202020 rather than inventing a color.

## Weight Inversion

Ventriloc inverts the conventional weight ladder. Display PolySans sits at 400 while body Inter sits at 500, so the largest text is the lightest-weighted and paragraphs carry more stroke per pixel than headlines do. This is the thesis restated in type: authority comes from scale (66px against 18px, a 3.67 ratio) and from tight −0.02em tracking, with stroke weight playing no part in it. The pattern breaks if headings go to 600, if body drops to 400 and turns spindly beside 0.91-leading display, or if a third family is introduced for emphasis. Extend it by adding sizes, not weights. A new 24px subheading belongs in PolySans 400 with −0.48px tracking, and new emphasis inside body copy uses #ff682c or #202020 color rather than Inter 600.

## Similar Brands

- **Slalom** — a data and Microsoft-stack consultancy that sells expertise through credential lines and named people rather than product screenshots, though Slalom leans on photography where Ventriloc uses a flat brass field.
- **Hex** — an analytics product that sets regular-weight grotesk display headlines on a near-white canvas with tonal panel separation and no heavy shadows.
- **Aesop** — a warm ochre-and-umber palette on neutral stone grays with weight-400 type, the closest match to Ventriloc's #816729 and #3c1e1a pairing.
- **Teenage Engineering** — a gray canvas with exactly one hot orange used as punctuation, mirroring how #ff682c is rationed to inline highlights.
- **Dept** — a digital agency layout of full-bleed sections, oversized display type at 0.9-range leading and a floating pill nav.
